title: Search query parameter type confusion bypasses input bounds and triggers request failures
closest_control: Base routes/search.ts:21-22 accepted only string q values; target line 21 removes that guard and assigns req.query.q as any.
sink: Target line 22 reads attacker-selected length and may invoke substring() on a non-string. Duplicate-key arrays can use element count rather than character count before SQL construction at line 23.
impact: Object-shaped q values can deterministically abort the request with TypeError/HTTP 500; duplicate q values can bypass the intended 200-character processing bound. Shared-service resource impact is not established.
scope_note: Raw SQL interpolation at target line 23 exists in both revisions and is not a diff-introduced candidate.
